1e2f692ed904536943d3e1cafffe1ec056940a83.caption: A rectangular outlined button containing a magnifying glass icon on the left and the bold text Search to its right. A vertical dimension marked x on the left shows the icon size, and a narrow dashed gap between the icon and the text is marked ½ x, meaning the clear space around the icon is half of the icon size.

1eeb1cb47c1d28f46495ede29212ec60298532fb.caption: The same dark magnifying glass icon shown five times in a row on a light background, scaled proportionally from very small on the left to large on the right, illustrating the recommended sizes 8 x 8px, 10 x 10px, 12 x 12px, 16 x 16px and 24 x 24px. The line thickness grows with the icon so the icon stays consistent and does not look coarse.

Small blue anchor points and bezier handles sit along its outline, as in a draft icon being created in the Figma Playground.

577dfe1c5be1d29dbacd58868b6b4a18bf3804ce.caption: Six dark, minimal line-style Functional Icons on a light background in two rows of three: search (magnifying glass), download (arrow pointing down onto a line) and shopping cart in the top row, and user (person), paperclip and email (envelope) in the bottom row.

6682d80c06e49f15aef86a555d14e03ab7ae0805.caption: Three white pictograms, each inside a grey circle of a different size, on a background split into a darker grey left half and a lighter grey right half: a small speedometer gauge at the top left, a crossed-out pair of ear protection headphones at the top right, and a large cloud with two raindrops at the bottom centre.
